compute.basis: Reproducing UniMod-3B requires building the UniTrace 18K consensus dataset via three proprietary teacher VLMs (Seed1.6-vision, GLM-4.5V, Gemini-2.5-Pro), training UniRM on the human-annotated UniReward corpus, then cold-start SFT plus GRPO RL (paper reports 10-15h on 8x H200 for the 3B dynamic variant), none of which is feasible on an 8-core CPU laptop.
